name: 이렘
visual_review: 푸른 눈·살구색 머리·고양이 귀와 의상을 유지했습니다. 6~9프레임은 실제 네발 고양이로 바뀌고 앞발·냥 펀치·앉기 뒤 인간으로 복귀합니다. 4번째 작은 점프는 의도된 모션입니다.
motion_summary: Irem peach-orange hair, cat ears, bright blue eyes, white pink red outfit and headband from portrait. Official R switches human Irem to a cat and back. Animate human idle; cute paws-up hand pose; knees dip; little jump; compact peach-pink transformation puff below visible face; now a small peach-orange cat with blue eyes, red collar and bell, tail curled on SAME ground baseline; cat stretches forepaws; one quick playful cat paw swipe with tiny white streak; sits with proud blue eyes and bell; cat curls into soft pink puff; human form lands paws raised; exact original human idle. Preserve human face rather than Nia eyes, and matching eye color as cat. Do NOT keep a human body with cat ears as transformation: frames 6-9 are a genuine four-legged cat. No huge opaque flash.
